scope: All current bank records with a primary or secondary Stage 3 Multiplicative relations B skill, including the adapted question. Other genuinely assessed Stage 3 skills remain.

before.difficultyReason: Choose and check the single operation relating each table; the operation itself is not supplied.

after.difficultyReason: Choose and check the single operation relating each table; the operation itself is not supplied.

questions.mappingNote: The source topic Finding the Rule from a Table introduces linear equations satisfying every x/y pair. All twelve parts require an equation, including additive and fractional-coefficient rules.

before.difficultyReason: Read points from graphs and choose between the supplied additive and multiplicative rule forms.

after.difficultyReason: Read points from graphs and choose between the supplied additive and multiplicative rule forms.

questions.mappingNote: Read six straight-line graphs, describe coordinate relationships and write equations of the supplied forms y=x+c or y=mx. This directly connects Stage 4 linear representations.

before.difficultyReason: Choose a rule from irregularly spaced table inputs, including a two-operation relationship.

after.difficultyReason: Choose a rule from irregularly spaced table inputs, including a two-operation relationship.

questions.mappingNote: Guided practice immediately follows examples y=x+9 and y=2x+1. Four tables require linear equations, including two-operation and fractional rules; the Stage 3 prerequisite adds no separate assessed task.

before.difficultyReason: Infer each simple rule from known pairs and apply it to complete the remaining outputs.

after.difficultyReason: Infer each simple rule from known pairs and apply it to complete the remaining outputs.

questions.mappingNote: The prompt explicitly asks for the equation of the line from each table, then applies it to missing outputs, including negative values.

before.difficultyReason: Recognise a common multiplier in signed coordinate pairs and express it as a line equation.

after.difficultyReason: Recognise a common multiplier in signed coordinate pairs and express it as a line equation.

questions.mappingNote: Recognise the pattern across signed coordinate pairs, describe the multiplier in words and generate the straight-line equation y=10x. The assessed response is an algebraic linear-pattern rule.

before.difficultyReason: Choose between addition and division rules for two selected tables.

after.difficultyReason: Choose between addition and division rules for two selected tables.

questions.mappingNote: Adapted two-part selection of source page 26 question 1. Both retained tables require a linear equation, y=x+3 and y=x/2; adaptation does not turn this into a Stage 3 multiples task.

before.difficultyReason: Read points on a line, recognise their shared offset and explain the corresponding equation.

after.difficultyReason: Read points on a line, recognise their shared offset and explain the corresponding equation.

questions.mappingNote: Read eight points on a Cartesian line, describe their coordinate relationship and explain y=x-1. The retained Stage 4 representation tag covers this task; the Stage 3 table-rule tag is incidental.
